## Hero Section

**Headline:**  
Creative Digital Content Designer for Scroll-Stopping Videos, Animations, and Brand Visuals

**Subheadline:**  
I help businesses, creators, and agencies grow faster with premium CapCut video editing, engaging 2D animation, and strategic graphic design using Canva, Photoshop, and Illustrator.

**CTA:**  
**Let’s Build Your Next High-Impact Project**  
*Message me now for a custom quote and turnaround plan.*

---

## About Me (120–150 words)

I’m a freelance digital content designer from Nepal, focused on delivering high-quality visual content for global clients. My expertise combines CapCut video editing, 2D animation, and graphic design in Canva, Photoshop, and Illustrator to create content that is both visually appealing and results-driven.  

I work with brands, entrepreneurs, and content creators who want clean, modern, and professional visuals that increase engagement and strengthen their identity. I am known for clear communication, reliable delivery, and attention to detail from concept to final output.  

Whether you need short-form videos, animated explainers, social media graphics, or brand-ready design assets, I provide creative solutions tailored to your goals, audience, and platform standards. My priority is simple: deliver work that looks premium, performs well, and helps your business grow.

---

## Services Section

1. **Short-Form Video Editing (CapCut)**  
   High-retention edits for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts with hooks, captions, transitions, and pacing optimized for engagement.

2. **YouTube & Long-Form Video Editing**  
   Clean storytelling edits with smooth cuts, sound balancing, motion graphics, and branding that improve watch time and professionalism.

3. **2D Animation & Motion Graphics**  
   Custom animated scenes, text animations, and explainer visuals that simplify messages and make content more memorable.

4. **Social Media Design Packs**  
   Branded post and story templates designed for consistency, faster publishing, and stronger visual identity across platforms.

5. **Branding & Marketing Graphics**  
   Professional banners, thumbnails, flyers, and promotional creatives that increase clicks and improve campaign performance.

6. **Thumbnail & Cover Design**  
   Attention-grabbing thumbnails and covers designed to boost CTR while staying aligned with your brand style.

7. **Canva Editable Design Systems**  
   Reusable Canva templates so you can scale content production with speed while maintaining premium design quality.

---

## Skills Section

### Video Editing
- **CapCut** — Advanced  
- **Short-Form Content Editing** — Advanced  
- **YouTube Editing Workflow** — Intermediate  
- **Audio Sync & Cleanup** — Intermediate  

### Animation
- **2D Animation Concepts** — Intermediate  
- **Motion Typography** — Advanced  
- **Animated Explainer Sequences** — Intermediate  

### Graphic Design
- **Canva (Brand + Social Assets)** — Advanced  
- **Adobe Photoshop** — Intermediate  
- **Adobe Illustrator** — Intermediate  
- **Layout & Visual Hierarchy** — Advanced  

---

## Portfolio Projects (Sample Ideas)

### 1) Project Name: Fitness Coach Reels Growth Pack  
- **Goal:** Increase Instagram engagement and lead generation through short-form videos  
- **Tools Used:** CapCut, Canva  
- **Outcome:** Delivered 20 branded reels; profile achieved stronger audience retention and more direct inquiry messages

### 2) Project Name: SaaS Product Explainer Animation  
- **Goal:** Simplify a software product’s value proposition for landing page visitors  
- **Tools Used:** Illustrator, CapCut (animation assembly), Canva (support visuals)  
- **Outcome:** Produced a 60-second explainer animation that improved clarity and supported higher demo interest

### 3) Project Name: E-commerce Promo Video Series  
- **Goal:** Create ad-ready product videos for seasonal campaigns  
- **Tools Used:** CapCut, Photoshop  
- **Outcome:** Delivered a multi-format video set (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) used across social ads and marketplace listings

### 4) Project Name: Personal Brand Content Kit  
- **Goal:** Build a consistent visual identity for a content creator  
- **Tools Used:** Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator  
- **Outcome:** Designed a full kit including post templates, thumbnails, and banners, resulting in a more professional brand presence

### 5) Project Name: Restaurant Launch Social Campaign  
- **Goal:** Promote grand opening with high-impact social visuals and motion posts  
- **Tools Used:** Canva, CapCut, Illustrator  
- **Outcome:** Created launch creatives and animated promos that helped drive local awareness and opening-week traffic

---

## Client Feedback Coming Soon (Ethical Placeholder Section)

**Section Title:**  
Client Feedback Coming Soon

**Placeholder Cards (for future real reviews):**
- “Client review will appear here after project completion and approval.”
- “Verified feedback from Fiverr/Upwork clients will be added here.”
- “This space is reserved for real project outcomes and client experience.”

**Ethical Review Collection Guidance:**
- Ask for feedback only after successful delivery and revisions are complete  
- Request honest reviews (never scripted or forced wording)  
- Collect reviews directly on Fiverr/Upwork whenever possible for verification  
- Save permission before displaying testimonial text on your personal website  
- Include project context (service + result) to make each review more credible  

---

## Contact Section

If you’re looking for a reliable creative partner for video editing, animation, or graphic design, I’d love to hear about your project. Share your goals, timeline, and platform, and I’ll recommend the best approach to deliver high-quality results.  

**Available for freelance projects, monthly content support, and long-term collaborations.**  
Let’s create content that looks premium and performs.

---

## Design Direction (Modern + High-Converting)

### Color Palette (Modern Premium)
- **Primary:** `#0F172A` (Deep Navy)  
- **Accent:** `#06B6D4` (Cyan)  
- **Highlight:** `#8B5CF6` (Violet)  
- **Background:** `#F8FAFC` (Soft Light)  
- **Text:** `#1E293B` (Slate)

### UI Style
- Clean + minimal base with cinematic accents (bold visuals, subtle gradients, smooth micro-interactions)  
- Strong spacing, clear section separation, and conversion-focused CTA buttons  
- Use portfolio thumbnails with hover animation for a premium feel

### Typography
- **Headings:** Poppins or Sora (bold, modern)  
- **Body:** Inter or Manrope (clean readability)  
- Keep heading contrast strong and body text short for fast scanning by clients

### Layout Ideas
- Sticky top CTA (“Hire Me” / “Get a Quote”)  
- Hero with short trust points (Fast Delivery, Clear Communication, Revision Support)  
- Service cards in 2–3 column responsive grid  
- Skills shown as tagged badges with level labels  
- Portfolio in visual cards with result-focused captions  
- Contact section with single clear action: **“Send Project Brief”**

---

If you want, I can also generate:
- a Fiverr profile description version,
- an Upwork overview version,
- and a one-page personal website copy version from this exact portfolio.
I’ll build this into a complete, modern one-page portfolio website now. First I’m checking the workspace structure, then I’ll create the site files with your full content and styling.
The workspace is empty, so I’m creating a fresh static site (`index.html`, `styles.css`, `script.js`) with your portfolio sections, premium styling, and a conversion-focused layout.
